items.originalTitle: How McLaren tried to mitigate its Las Vegas F1 top speed deficit
items.summaryEn: In Friday qualifying for the Las Vegas Grand Prix, McLaren drivers Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri were at a disadvantage due to a lack of top speed, with Norris ending up fifth, nearly eight tenths behind polesitter Kimi Antonelli.
detailZh: 迈凯伦如何缓解拉斯维加斯F1直道速度劣势
由于兰多·诺里斯和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里的最高速度不足，这对迈凯伦车手不得不充分利用拉斯维加斯的赛道位置博弈
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里，迈凯伦，兰多·诺里斯，迈凯伦
尽管在这条放大了MCL40缺陷而不奖励其优点的赛道上取得了还算体面的成绩，兰多·诺里斯对拉斯维加斯大奖赛周末周五的表现并不满意。
“我们在直道上简直太糟糕了，”诺里斯在排位赛获得第五名后不久说道，他落后杆位得主基米·安东内利近0.8秒，后者因引擎罚单将退后五位，使诺里斯在发车格上升至第四。
长直道和低下压力需求意味着拉斯维加斯大道赛道从来不会成为这辆赛车最强的赛道，正如迈凯伦在蒙扎和巴库这两个最接近的对比赛道上表现平淡所预示的那样。
但迈凯伦在拉斯维加斯的差距仍然大得令人惊讶，至少对安东内利来说是这样，诺里斯和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在拉斯维加斯大道的长直道以及通往终点的最后一段直道上通常都慢了20公里/小时。
如此巨大的差异很少仅仅归因于单一因素，周五的情况也证明了这一点。尽管有定期升级，MCL40仍然相对阻力较大且空气动力学效率不高，而车队在季前选择采用更短的传动比，使其在拥有极长直道的赛道上损失了最高速的爆发力。
与所有车队一样，迈凯伦本可以选择在赛季中期对齿轮比进行一次调整，但最终决定不这么做，因为其较短的齿比在其他赛道上仍然能带来优势。然而在拉斯维加斯，车队不得不为此付出代价。

当被 Motorsport.com 问及车队的劣势是否比预期更严重时，车队领队安德烈亚·斯特拉回答说：“我们确实有些担心这条赛道的要求对我们的赛车有多适合。这不仅仅是最高速度的问题，还涉及最高速度与大家都在努力利用的尾流效应的结合。因此，你会进入发动机在某些工况下的运转状态，而用我们的齿比来说并不理想。我们知道从空气动力学角度来看，阻力并不是我们的强项。我们看到了与蒙扎、巴库相似的特征。而在所有条件下，我们都不是特别有竞争力。”
由于尾流效应如此关键——这一点从主导第三节排位赛并让伊萨克·哈贾尔和乔治·拉塞尔等人付出代价的位置战术中可见一斑——迈凯伦试图通过更积极地追逐尾流来弥补最高速度的不足。
斯特拉补充说：“我们在这里做得更好的是通过非常好的位置安排来缓解这一问题。在排位赛中，赛车几乎处于我们想要的位置。这确实有帮助。因为我必须说，在这些规则下，当你跟随一辆甚至多辆赛车时，阻力减少似乎比过去更多。因此，处于正确位置的激励甚至更高。”
诺里斯详细解释道：“我必须在距离前车1.5秒的地方开始我的飞驰圈，这意味着在每个弯道我至少会损失半成到一成的时间，因为我损失的了下压力太多了。显然，最终拥有一个好的尾流会带来更大的收益，但我们不得不弥补直线速度的严重损失——因此我们必须牺牲我们的过弯速度。”
再加上外部因素，安东内利在小红牛和阿尔派车队的一群赛车末尾获得了“极端”的尾流，迈凯伦的真实差距可能被夸大了。两位车手在直道上损失的时间远不及安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔，也不及马克斯·维斯塔潘——后者将在周六因安东内利五位的发车位罚退而继承杆位。
尽管如此，皮亚斯特里认为迈凯伦最高速度劣势的幅度比预期更大，不过他也承认自己第七快的成绩是一圈混乱的飞驰圈所致。“说实话，这让我们感到意外，”这位澳大利亚车手说。“我认为我们没料到这会是个这么大的问题。在蒙扎我们还行，对我们来说奇怪的是，这主要是与其他梅赛德斯动力赛车相比。”
“我认为有几件事我们可能会复盘，看看能否做得稍微好一点。但我觉得我的圈速也有点混乱。”
斯特拉对迈凯伦修改后的底板持乐观态度，该底板由诺里斯在维加斯试用，并帮助提升了低速性能，但这位意大利人透露了一个不寻常的原因，说明为何该升级的性能收益在很大程度上被抵消了。
“在兰多这边，一个塑料袋卡在了底板里，我们在那里损失了相当多的下压力。所以，考虑到十分之一秒就会带来很大差别，那个塑料袋上肯定有十分之一秒的损失，这有点可惜。
“但现在我们需要研究如何在正赛中保持赛车的可比赛性。在蒙扎我们看到，由于这种尾流效应，你实际上可以保持纠缠、与其他赛车相连。所以我们肯定期待明天，并且排位赛一直很有竞争力这一事实令我们感到鼓舞。”
detailEn: How McLaren tried to mitigate its Las Vegas F1 top speed deficit
With Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri down on top speed, the McLaren pair had to make the most of Las Vegas's track position games
Oscar Piastri, McLaren, Lando Norris, McLaren

Despite what was a respectable result on a circuit that accentuated the MCL40's flaws without rewarding its virtues, Lando Norris was not best pleased with how Friday at the Las Vegas Grand Prix weekend.

“We're just shocking on the straights,” said Norris shortly after qualifying fifth, just under eight tenths behind polesitter Kimi Antonelli, who is set to drop five places for an engine penalty, elevating Norris to fourth on the grid.

The long straights and low downforce demands meant the Las Vegas Strip circuit was never going to be the strongest track for this car, as foreshadowed by McLaren's muted form on the circuit's nearest comparisons in Monza and Baku.

But McLaren's deficit in Vegas was still surprisingly vast, at least to Antonelli, with Norris and Oscar Piastri routinely 20km/h down on the circuit's long Las Vegas Boulevard as well as the final straight towards the finish.

Differences so massive are rarely just down to one single factor, and that also proved to be the case on Friday. Despite regular upgrades, the MCL40 remains relatively draggy and aerodynamically inefficient, which is compounded by the team's pre-season choice to go for a shorter gearing, costing it top-end grunt on circuits with extremely long straights.

Like all teams, McLaren had the option to make one mid-season change to its gear ratios, but decided against it because its shorter gearing would still stand it in good stead on other circuits. In Vegas, though, the team had to pay the price.

"Definitely we had some concern in terms of how suitable the demands of this circuit would be for our car," team principal Andrea Stella replied when asked by Motorsport.com whether the squad's deficit was more severe than anticipated. "This is not only the top speed, it is also the top speed that is combined with the towing that everyone is trying to do. So, you go in operating regimes of the engine that with our ratios is not ideal. We know that the drag from an aerodynamic point of view is not a point of strength. We have seen traits that are similar to Monza, to Baku. And in all conditions we were not particularly competitive."

With slipstreaming so crucial, as evidenced by the positional tactics that dominated Q3 and cost the likes of Isack Hadjar and George Russell, McLaren tried to compensate for its lack of top speed by more aggressively chasing the tow.

"What we have done better here is to mitigate this by having really good positioning," Stella added. "The car was pretty much where we wanted it to be in qualifying. And this definitely helped. Because I have to say that it seems like with these regulations the drag reduction when you follow one car or even multiple cars is more than in the past. And therefore, there is an even higher incentive to be positioned in the right place."

Norris elaborated: “I have to start my lap 1.5 seconds off the car ahead, which means in every corner I'm losing at least half a tenth to a tenth, because of how much downforce I'm losing. There's obviously a bigger gain at the end of the day in having a good slipstream, but we're having to make up for a really terrible loss of straight-line speed - and therefore we have to harm our cornering speed."

Add in the external factor of Antonelli receiving an "extreme" tow at the end of a gaggle of cars from Racing Bulls and Alpine, and McLaren's real deficit has probably been exaggerated. Neither driver lost nearly as much time on the straights to Antonelli's team-mate George Russell or indeed Max Verstapppen, who will inherit pole on Saturday due to Antonelli's five-place grid penalty.

Still, Piastri felt the size of McLaren's top speed disadvantage was bigger than expected, though he also admitted his seventh-fastest time was the result of a messy lap. "t caught us by surprise, to be honest," the Australian said. "I don't think we expected it to be such a big problem. At Monza we were okay and the strange part for us is it's mostly compared to the other Mercedes-powered cars.
"I think there were a few things that we probably will review and see if we can do a slightly better job. But I think also my laps were a little bit messy."

Stella was upbeat about McLaren's revised floor which was trialled by Norris in Vegas and helped low-speed performance, but the Italian revealed an unusual reason why that upgrade's performance benefit was largely cancelled out.

"On Lando's side, a plastic bag got stuck in the floor and we lost quite a lot of downforce there. So, considering that one tenth of a second would make a big difference, certainly there was one tenth of a second on a plastic bag, which is a bit of a shame.

"But now we need to look at how we keep the car raceable in the race. At Monza we saw that because of this towing effect you actually can stay tangled, linked to the other cars. So we are definitely looking forward to tomorrow and encouraged by the fact that qualifying has been competitive."

items.originalTitle: Kimi Antonelli and George Russell set for Mercedes talks over Las Vegas GP qualifying woes
detailZh: 基米·安东内利和乔治·拉塞尔将就拉斯维加斯大奖赛排位赛的困境与梅赛德斯进行会谈
安东内利在拉斯维加斯的排位赛中速度最快，拉塞尔排名第三，但他们的策略并未按计划进行
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利、梅赛德斯、乔治·拉塞尔、梅赛德斯
乔治·拉塞尔和基米·安东内利将在团队指令和赛道位置出现混乱后，就一级方程式拉斯维加斯大奖赛排位赛的后果进行“线下”讨论。
周五晚上的排位赛中，交通状况扮演了重要角色，车手们不愿意第一个出发，因为在这个低下压力的街道赛赛道上，被拖曳的优势很大。
由于有五位车手需要接受发车位处罚，他们的主要任务是帮助队友，比如哈斯车队的奥利弗·贝尔曼在Q1中给拉斐尔·卡马拉提供拖曳。
安东内利也是其中之一，因为更换新引擎被降了五位发车位，所以计划是在争夺杆位的比赛中给拉塞尔提供尾流，但很快计划就破产了。
这是因为梅赛德斯车队的双雄在最后一圈被夹在阿尔卑斯车队和小红牛车队之间，尽管试图寻找空间，但有时却不得不进行三车并排。
安东内利最终在5号弯道减速，而拉塞尔不情愿地成为车队的领跑者，2026年的世界冠军在排位赛中速度最快，他的队友落后0.331秒排在第三。
当被问及之后是否希望得到安东内利的帮助时，拉塞尔回答说：“如果你有发车罚分，尽可能从更高的位置起步仍然很重要。”
“但我们会私下讨论这个问题。我认为明天的比赛将非常接近，就像蒙扎一样——要想从车队中脱颖而出将非常具有挑战性。”
“我本希望站在杆位，但我认为只要在顶尖的前七名位置，你就有机会竞争。”
这种情况让梅赛德斯车队老板Toto Wolff对安东内利能最快感到难以置信，尤其是因为拉塞尔没有得到他离开维修区第二位的请求。
“这非常危险，”拉塞尔补充道，他将与红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘一起占据前排，因为安东内利的处罚。
“基米获得了杆位，但如果他晚出发一秒，他就无法完成这一圈了。
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯
“因为每个人都想要这么做，而且有一半的赛车在做准备圈，另一半的赛车没有，这也使得事情变得很困难。”
“如果你可以选择，你会在九辆车的一组中排在最后，大约有3秒的差距，如果你能完美选择的话。”
“但这就是每个人都追求的，所以这有点像2019年的蒙扎。”
“尽管安东内利最终退后给了他设置最快圈速所需的空间，1分33.893秒，但这可能让他付出了代价，因为他刚好及时冲过终点线开始最后一圈。”
“正如乔治所说，我们会讨论这件事，因为我们总是在排位赛中被派到前面，”安东内利说。
“关于5号弯，这完全是我的责任。就像我说的，我们一开始就是三车并排，我只是说，'你知道什么？我要减速。'”，
“这很棘手，首先，我差点错过了旗帜。是的，我确实受到了很大的牵引，但我离得太近，以至于在脏空气中等情况下绕过弯角实际上很困难。”
“我们已经使用了低下压力套件，所以当你跟车时，你更能感觉到损失。”
“但总的来说，这只是那种你认为你完了，但实际上却成功了的情况。”
“在第五弯道，我决定减速。我并不真的知道我的时间安排有多紧张。我可能本会做得不同，但事后看来，结果仍然不错。”
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli and George Russell set for Mercedes talks over Las Vegas GP qualifying woes
Antonelli was fastest in qualifying at Las Vegas with Russell third, but their strategy did not go as planned
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, George Russell, Mercedes
George Russell and Kimi Antonelli will discuss the fallout from Formula 1’s Las Vegas Grand Prix qualifying “offline” following confusion over team orders and track position.
Traffic played a significant role in qualifying on Friday night with drivers reluctant to go first, considering the advantage of a tow is huge around the low-downforce street circuit.
There was the added complexity of five drivers taking a grid penalty, so their primary role was to help their team-mate like Haas’ Oliver Bearman giving Rafael Camara a tow in Q1.
Antonelli was another one of those, taking a five-place drop for a new engine, so the plan was to give Russell the slipstream in the fight for pole but it quickly unravelled.
That was because the Mercedes duo got caught in a pack with both Alpine and Racing Bulls cars ahead of the final lap, at times going three-wide despite trying to find space.
Antonelli eventually backed off at Turn 5 while Russell reluctantly went first of the pack and the 2026 world champion was fastest in qualifying with his team-mate 0.331s off in third.
So when asked afterwards if he was hoping for assistance from Antonelli, Russell replied: “It's still important, if you've got a grid penalty, to start as high up the order as possible.
“But we'll take it offline and we can talk about it. I think tomorrow is going to be very close between everybody, similar to Monza - it'll be very challenging to pull away from the pack.
“I would have liked to have been on pole, but I think anywhere in the top seven positions and you're in the fight.”
The situation caused Mercedes boss Toto Wolff to express disbelief at how Antonelli was quickest, particularly because Russell didn’t receive his request of leaving the pits second.
“It's very high risk,” added Russell, who will share the front row with Red Bull’s Max Verstappen due to Antonelli’s penalty.
“Kimi got the pole, but if he started the lap a second later, he wouldn't have got the lap in.
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, George Russell, Mercedes
“It's very difficult to orchestrate because everybody's going for it, and also the fact that half the cars were doing prep laps and half the cars were not also made it difficult.
“If you could choose, you would be at the back of a pack of nine cars with around a three-second gap, if you could perfectly choose.
“But that's what everyone's chasing, so it's kind of like Monza 2019."
Although Antonelli eventually backing off gave him the space needed to set his fastest lap, a 1m33.893s, it could have cost him as he only just crossed the line in time to start his final tour.
“As George said, we will talk about it because we've been sent out at the front in qualifying always,” said Antonelli.
“About Turn 5, it was fully on me. Like I said, we were three-wide, first of all, and I just said, "You know what? I'm just going to back off’."
“It was tricky because, first of all, I almost missed the flag. Yes, I did get a big tow, but I was also so close that getting around the corner was actually difficult with the dirty air and so on.
“We're already on a lower-downforce package, so you do feel even more the loss when following.
“But overall, it was just one of those times where you think you're screwed, but actually it works out.
“On Turn 5, I just decided to back off. I didn't really know how tight I was with the timing. I probably would have done it differently, but in hindsight, it still worked out.”

detailZh: 维斯塔潘分享对法拉利F1 2026速度不足的理论
除了较小的涡轮，维斯塔潘还指出法拉利的"排气吹拂"问题。在拉斯维加斯这样的赛道上，速度不足尤为明显。
尽管维斯塔潘对他在拉斯维加斯大奖赛排位赛中第二快的时间并不满意，指出小红牛22存在神秘问题，但观察法拉利的情况显示情况可能更加糟糕。
自2025年伊莫拉以来，法拉利车队首次在Q2阶段两辆赛车都被淘汰，之后刘易斯·汉密尔顿解释说地板损坏和部署问题阻碍了他。他估计缺失的地板部分让他失去了三到四十分之一秒，而部署问题又让他失去了另外六十分之一秒。
尽管如此，法拉利事先就已经知道拉斯维加斯赛道对SF-26来说将是一个相当大的挑战。这部分原因与有意的工程设计选择有关。法拉利使用的涡轮比大多数其他动力单元制造商都要小，这使得位于马拉内洛的法拉利车队在起步时具有优势，尤其是在今年年初，但也对整体动力产生了影响。
法拉利获得了两个ADUO代币，这意味着根据国际汽联的测量，这家意大利制造商在最佳内燃机引擎上落后了2%到4%，而红牛的引擎就是最佳内燃机引擎。
在拉斯维加斯，这一点尤其痛苦，因为当导流板在长直道上启动时，F1车手必须完全依赖内燃机的动力在一定时间内行驶。
这解释了为什么法拉利在最高速度上如此缺乏动力，尽管维斯塔潘看到了另一个影响因素。
“他们显然缺乏顶级速度，但这与他们的排气吹拂设计方式有关。因为如果你看看哈斯，直道上这个问题要小得多，”当Motorsport.com问他关于法拉利灾难性的排位赛时，维斯塔潘说。
“这始终是你要多少下压力和愿意为此牺牲多少动力的结合。你把排气前面的那个东西做得越大，你失去的动力就越多。所以从某种程度上说，这显然也在他们自己的掌控之中。”
维斯塔潘指的是法拉利的排气翼，这是斯库德里亚今年开创的概念。它有助于产生额外的下压力，但维斯塔潘认为它也可能成为拉斯维加斯等赛道长直道上的额外障碍。
“在这样的赛道上，这确实可能是一个大障碍。所以你可能需要稍微适应一下，但这显然是他们自己必须解决的问题！”
红牛车队在能源匮乏的赛道上取得了显著的进步。在今年年初，这类赛场的效率仍然是我们的弱点，尤其是与梅赛德斯相比，但红牛福特动力系统在整个赛季中在该领域获得了大量的知识。
"一开始，我们的赛车显然有很多问题，而且在动力单元方面也没有完全掌握。我认为这自动意味着我们有一些更容易的步骤要走，但我们仍然完成了这些步骤。这是我们值得骄傲的事情。"
除了纯粹的性能之外，执行也是拉斯维加斯的一个主要因素。尾流产生了极端的影响，许多车手表示，这甚至比他们之前经历过的任何事情都要大，这使得法拉利车手在排位赛中大部分时间没有尾流显得更加令人惊讶。
考虑到他们缺乏最高速度，这似乎是一种奇怪的方法，尽管维斯塔潘不愿意在这方面对法拉利过于苛刻。
“嗯，这是从外面看的。我只专注于我们自己的车队。当然，我们的目标始终是尽可能少犯错误，尽可能多地掌握一切。我认为我们在今天的执行方面做得相当不错。”
detailEn: Max Verstappen shares theory on Ferrari's lack of top speed in F1 2026
Besides the smaller turbo, Verstappen also points to Ferrari's "exhaust blowing". The lack of top speed is particularly painful at a circuit like Las Vegas

Although Max Verstappen was not entirely satisfied with his second-fastest time in qualifying for the Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix – pointing to a mysterious issue with the RB22 – a glance at Ferrari shows that things could have been considerably worse.

For the first time since Imola 2025, the Scuderia saw both cars eliminated in Q2, after which Lewis Hamilton explained that floor damage and deployment issues had hampered him. He estimated that the missing section of the floor had cost him three to four tenths, while the deployment issue had cost him another six tenths.

That said, Ferrari already knew beforehand that the Las Vegas circuit would pose a considerable challenge for the SF-26. This is partly related to deliberate design choices. Ferrari runs a smaller turbo than most other power unit manufacturers, which gave the Maranello-based team an advantage off the line, particularly at the start of this year, but also has implications for outright power.

Ferrari has received two ADUO tokens, meaning that, according to FIA measurements, the Italian manufacturer was between 2% and 4% down on the best internal combustion engine on the grid, Red Bull's unit.
In Las Vegas, that is particularly painful, as clipping kicks in on the long straight and F1 drivers then have to rely solely on the internal combustion engine's power for a certain period.
This partly explains why Ferrari is lacking so much top speed, although Verstappen sees another contributing factor.

"They are obviously lacking top speed, but that has to do with the way they have designed their exhaust blowing as well. Because if you look at Haas, it's much less of an issue on the straight," Verstappen said when Motorsport.com asked him about Ferrari's disastrous qualifying session.

"It's always a combination of how much downforce you want to have and how much power you're willing to sacrifice for it. The bigger you make that thing in front of the exhaust, the more power you lose. So to some extent, it's obviously in their own hands as well."

Verstappen is referring to Ferrari's exhaust wing, a concept the Scuderia has pioneered this year. It helps generate additional downforce, but Verstappen believes it can also become an extra handicap on the long straights of tracks such as Las Vegas.
"At a circuit like this, it can indeed be a major handicap. So perhaps you have to adapt a little to that, but that's obviously something they have to figure out for themselves!"

Red Bull, meanwhile, has made significant strides on energy-poor circuits. At the start of this year, efficiency at such venues was still a weakness, particularly compared to Mercedes, but Red Bull Ford Powertrains has gained a great deal of knowledge in that area over the course of the season.

"At the beginning, we obviously had a lot of problems with our car and we weren't quite on top of things with the power unit either. I think that automatically meant we had some easier steps to make, but we still made those steps. And that's something we should be proud of."

Aside from outright performance, execution is also a major factor in Las Vegas. The slipstream had an extreme effect, with many drivers saying it was even greater than anything they had experienced before, making it all the more surprising that the Ferrari drivers were mostly without a slipstream during qualifying.
Particularly given their lack of top speed, that seems a strange approach, although Verstappen preferred not to be too critical of Ferrari in that respect.

"Well, that's judging from the outside. I just focus on our own team. Of course, our goal is always to make as few mistakes as possible and to stay on top of everything as much as we can. I think we did a pretty good job in terms of execution today."

在拉斯维加斯这样的赛道上，速度不足尤为明显。
自2025年伊莫拉以来，法拉利车队首次在Q2阶段两辆赛车都被淘汰。

items.originalTitle: Fernando Alonso: Honda lacks so much power that rivals take extra margin behind us
items.summaryEn: Fernando Alonso says Honda's power deficit is so severe that other cars are taking extra margin around the Aston Martins at the Las Vegas Grand Prix. He and Lance Stroll both failed to escape Q1.
detailZh: 阿隆索：本田动力不足，对手在阿斯顿·马丁身后留出额外余量
阿隆索感叹阿斯顿·马丁在直道上损失了三秒
阿隆索表示，本田的动力不足非常严重，在拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，其他赛车在阿斯顿·马丁身后都留出了额外余量。
拉斯维加斯街道赛道有一段接近2公里的全油门路段，外界原本预计这会暴露日本动力单元的短板。阿隆索和斯特罗尔不出所料未能从第一节排位赛晋级，这位两届世界冠军比晋级第二节的关门时间慢1.251秒。
有趣的是，阿隆索距离标杆乔治·拉塞尔也有2.736秒之差，而他的评估暗示，如果拥有一台顶级引擎，他本可以跻身最前列。
“完全如预期，”这位老将评论道。“蒙扎和维加斯拥有最长的直道，是对我们最不利的赛道。我们在直道上损失了大约2.5秒或3秒。
“老实说，在弯道中我们相当有竞争力。我认为我们在第一节排位赛中距离第一名2.8秒，而我想我们在直道上大致损失了这么多。”
阿斯顿·马丁在排位赛中的最高速度为290.8公里/小时，相比之下，迈凯伦以323.9公里/小时成为最快赛车，红牛以305.6公里/小时位列第二慢。
当被问及是否对速度差异存在安全担忧时，阿隆索回答说：“我认为其他车队，他们知道。当他们在本田引擎后面时，他们会多留出几米的距离。”
这位两届世界冠军将他驾驶AMR26赛车的体验描述为“演示圈”，并且似乎宁愿不在拉斯维加斯，因为他认为F1赛历中的这一站毫无意义。
“我们两周前在奥斯汀和墨西哥，相距两小时路程，”他指出。“然后我们去了巴西，接着又去了欧洲。我们回到这里待72小时，然后又回欧洲，因为我们要在卡塔尔比赛，所以这个周末安排比赛毫无道理。”
然而，阿斯顿·马丁的困境至少让一个人感到高兴。塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯以第18名追平了他本赛季的最佳排位赛成绩（不含冲刺赛），比阿隆索快了0.017秒。
佩雷斯说：“这很好。领先于他们（指对手）是积极的。不幸的是，距离哈斯车队还差了一点。借助尾流，我们本可以更接近一些，但还不够——其实什么也改变不了。”
detailEn: Fernando Alonso: Honda lacks so much power that rivals take extra margin behind us
Alonso laments a three-second loss on straights for Aston Martin
Fernando Alonso says Honda’s power deficit is so dire that other cars are taking extra margin around the Aston Martins at Formula 1’s Las Vegas Grand Prix.

The Nevadan street circuit was expected to expose the Japanese power unit’s deficiencies, with a near-2km full-throttle portion. Alonso and Lance Stroll unsurprisingly failed to escape Q1, where the two-time world champion was 1.251s down on the Q2 cut-off time.
Interestingly, Alonso also was 2.736s away from pacesetter George Russell, and his assessment implied that he could have been right at the front with a top engine.
“Exactly as expected,” the veteran commented. “Monza and Vegas are the worst tracks for us with the longest straights. We lost like 2.5 seconds or three seconds on the straights.
“On the corners we were quite competitive to be honest. I think we were 2.8 from P1 in Q1, and I think we lost more or less that on the straights.”
Aston’s top speed in qualifying was 290.8km/h, to be compared with McLaren’s 323.9km/h as the fastest car and Red Bull’s 305.6km/h as the second-slowest.
Asked if there were safety concerns about the speed differential, Alonso replied: “I think the other teams, they know. When they are behind the Honda engine, they take extra metres.”
The two-time world champion described his experience at the wheel of the AMR26 as a “demo lap” and seemingly would rather not be in Las Vegas, as he reckons this part of F1’s calendar makes no sense.

“We've been in Austin and Mexico two weeks ago, two hours away,” he pointed out. “Then we went to Brazil and then we went to Europe. We come back here for 72 hours and we go back to Europe because we race in Qatar, so it doesn't make sense to have the race in this weekend.”
Aston’s hardship, however, has made at least one person happy. Sergio Perez equalled his best qualifying result of the season (sprints excluded) in 18th, having outpaced Alonso by 0.017s.

“It's nice,” Perez said. “It's positive to be ahead of them. Unfortunately, just a little bit too far from the Haas. With a tow, we could have been a little bit closer, but not quite – nothing could have changed, really.”

items.originalTitle: What 'crazy' tow was actually worth in Vegas qualifying
detailZh: 在拉斯维加斯的F1排位赛中，从另一辆车中获得牵引至关重要，没有什么能像基米·安东内利的最佳圈速那样，展示出‘疯狂’的收益。
尽管安东内利由于赛道处罚无法从杆位发车，但在排位赛中他是最快的，尽管他‘对赛车没有感觉’并且Q3阶段的最后一圈比预想的更接近阿维德·林德布拉德的小红牛车队。
然而，牵引效果如此强大，安东内利在林德布拉德启动圈速内两秒处起步，最终仅落后0.6秒，并在两条最长的直道上获得了惊人的尾流。
他从中受益是显而易见的，安东内利也迅速承认了这一点：‘我以为我完蛋了，但这里的牵引太强大了，我能够仅仅通过它来提升成绩。’
然而，他从麦拉伦车队老板安德烈亚·斯特拉所说的“一个非常极端的案例”中获得的程度令人印象深刻。
牵引和没有牵引之间的差异很大，从0.5-1.0秒不等，具体取决于你比较的是谁的圈速。奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂甚至说“如果你没有做到这一点，你甚至都不用出去”。
维斯塔潘和拉塞尔在Q3的各自最佳圈速中，从领先他们三秒多的车辆那里获得了轻微的牵引，而兰多·诺里斯在跑出比队友皮亚斯蒂快两秒的圈速时，也得到了很好的牵引。
但没有人能接近安东内利。当他通过整个赛道逼近林德布拉德时，安东内利在所有四个直道上都获得了强大的牵引和直线速度优势。
这是一个他本不应该出现在的地方，如果不是因为他明智地退出了混乱的多车追逐战，争夺赛道位置。
这使安东内利在计时器耗尽之前开始最后一圈的时间紧迫，也意味着他的轮胎准备受到了影响，但这种方式给了他意想不到的巨大回报。他主动出击，掌控了自己的局势，显然也有些运气在他得到回报的时候。
当所有九辆车在最后一节Q3的比赛中几乎同时开始他们的圈数，安东内利排在最后——在赛道上，安东内利在Strip上大约有四辆车，每多一辆车在队列中都会带来一点额外的牵引力，这超出了林德布拉德的主要尾流。
“牵引力是疯狂的，”领先安东内利的驾驶员皮埃尔·加斯利说。
“如果你看看安东内利的最后一段，你就明白有多强大。我从未在任何一辆车上感受过这样的力量。”
不出所料，安东内利在每一段直道上都比前四名快了0.9-1.4秒，但同时在每个弯道部分也是最慢的，刹车最早，最低速度慢了几公里每小时，总共损失了大约0.6-1.0秒在污染的空气中。
与图表上的其他三人相比，他在The Strip上就比他们快了半秒以上，然后在16号弯到终点线的跑道上快了0.2-0.5秒（诺里斯的麦克拉伦在这里直道上特别慢，比安东内利慢20公里每小时）。
他的最高速度优势由于每个人的引擎开始超级剪切并即使在全油门下也减速而略有减弱。
这就是安东内利说自己是“仅靠最后一段赛道”才取得最快成绩的原因——这比队友乔治·拉塞尔的最佳成绩快了0.480秒，比马克斯·维斯塔潘最快的第三段赛道快了0.908秒。
这超过了安东内利在第一、二段赛道上比维斯塔潘和兰多·诺里斯慢了大约六十分之一秒的劣势，在那里红牛和麦克拉伦比奔驰车队都快。
维斯塔潘表示“在直线上的速度提升简直疯狂”并且说“我在Q3的第一圈几乎已经是最快了”——这简直不是被拖车辅助的安东内利的对手。尽管安东内利在通过弯道时在脏空气中行驶的负面影响方面做得很好，但这个布局在这一年中可以说是最友好的了。
这本来可能是一个安东内利只排在第四快的排位赛，如果一切正常进行的话。然而，正如他所说：“那是一种你认为你完蛋了，但实际上却成功了的情况。”
detailEn: Getting a tow from another car was absolutely critical in Formula 1 qualifying in Las Vegas, with nothing demonstrating how “crazy” the gain could be like Kimi Antonelli’s session-topping lap.

Though Antonelli will not actually start from pole due to a grid penalty, he was fastest in qualifying despite having “zero feeling with the car” and spending most of his final lap in Q3 much closer than intended to Arvid Lindblad’s Racing Bulls.

So powerful was the tow effect, though, that Antonelli benefitted significantly overall by starting the lap within two seconds of Lindblad, finishing it barely 0.6s behind and getting a stunning slipstream down the two longest straights.
That he benefited was obvious, and Antonelli was swift to acknowledge it: “I thought I was screwed but the tow is so big here that I was able to just gain with that.”
However, the full extent of how he gained from what McLaren team boss Andrea Stella called a "really extreme case" of slipstreaming was remarkable to see.
The difference between a tow and no tow was vast, anywhere from 0.5-1.0s depending on whose laps you compare. Oscar Piastri even said “you might as well not even go out if you don't get that right”.

Verstappen and Russell were picking up slight tows from cars just over three seconds ahead on their respective best laps in Q3, while Lando Norris had a good tow from running within two seconds of team-mate Piastri on his fastest.
But none of them came close to Antonelli. As he closed on Lindblad through the lap, Antonelli ended up with a strong tow and straightline speed advantage on all four straights.
It was a place he would not have been in had he not had the good sense to back out of a messy, multi-car fight for track position on his outlap.

That did put Antonelli in a race against time to start his final lap before the timer ran out on the session, and meant his tyre preparation was compromised, but it paid him back big time in a way Antonelli had not intended. He was proactive, took control of his situation, and there was obviously some fortune in how he was then rewarded.

As all nine cars on their final Q3 runs started their laps within 17s of each other, and Antonelli was last in the queue – on the Strip Antonelli had four cars within about six seconds, and each extra car in the queue added a little more of a tow benefit on top of the primary slipstream from Lindblad.
“The tow was insane,” said Pierre Gasly, who was one of the drivers ahead of Antonelli.
“If you look at the last sector of Antonelli, you just understand how powerful. I've never, ever felt that in a car.”

Unsurprisingly, Antonelli was the quickest of the top four on every straight by an overall gain of 0.9-1.4s depending on the comparison, but the slowest through every corner section at the same time, braking earliest and running a few km/h slower minimum speed totalling a loss of around 0.6-1.0s in the dirty air.

He seemed to gain over half a second down The Strip alone compared to the other three on the graph above, then between 0.2s and 0.5s on the run out of Turn 16 to the finish line (Norris’s McLaren being particularly slow on the straight here and 20km/h down on Antonelli).
His sheer top speed advantage was augmented by a slightly reduced effect as everyone’s engines began superclipping and slowing down even while on full throttle.

That’s why Antonelli said qualifying fastest was “only thanks to the final sector” – which was 0.480s quicker than team-mate George Russell’s best and a mammoth 0.908s clear of Max Verstappen’s fastest sector three.
This more than offset the six tenths or so Antonelli lost to Verstappen and Lando Norris in the first two sectors, where the Red Bull and McLaren were faster than both Mercedes.

Verstappen said “it's just insane how much you gain on the straights” and that “my first lap in Q3 was pretty much as good as it can be” – it was just no match for a tow-assisted Antonelli. And though Antonelli did a good job to mitigate the negative effect of running in dirty air through the corners, this layout is about as friendly to that as any could be all year.

This could easily have been a qualifying session in which Antonelli was only fourth-fastest had it played out normally. Instead, as he said: “It was just one of those times where you think you're screwed, but actually it works out.”

与巴西站一样，小红牛22给维斯塔潘的感觉并不对。这位荷兰车手无法透露敏感信息，但暗示红牛今年可能无法解决这一问题
由于安东内利的发车格罚退，维斯塔潘将从F1拉斯维加斯大奖赛杆位起步，但这未必是这位荷兰车手感到满意的理由。
是的，红牛在能量匮乏型赛道上动力单元取得了明显进步，并且在练习赛中出现的平衡问题之后，车队也成功做出了有效的调校调整，但驾驶座舱内的感受仍不是维斯塔潘认为应有的样子。
维斯塔潘表示：“其实从巴西站开始，赛车就出现了一些奇怪的问题，这个周末依然存在。我只能努力想办法在剩余的周末里应对它。”
“这让第三次练习变得不太轻松，但我认为我们在排位赛中设法让它运转起来了。”
当维斯塔潘在新闻发布会上被问及能否详细说明那些“奇怪的问题”时，他坚定地回答：“不能。”
尽管如此，这个话题在他随后于围场接受荷兰媒体采访时自然又被提起。维斯塔潘仍然无法详细说明，但透露了更多情况。
“我可以告诉你，这不是平衡问题。赛车就是有地方不对劲，但我们现在没法解决，”这位红牛车手在被 Motorsport.com 问及该问题时说道。
“我们知道问题出在哪里，但解决不了。这已经是连续第二个周末出现这种情况了，但我不能多说。”
表面上看，这个问题似乎是在巴西站正赛期间出现的。毕竟，维斯塔潘曾报告说，赛车在第二和第三阶段（stint）的感觉与开局阶段截然不同，但这位荷兰车手澄清说，这个问题实际上困扰他的时间更长。
“是的，它是在巴西突然出现的，但那已经是在正赛之前了。整个周末我在那里都有问题。”
这位四届世界冠军澄清，这与他此前在蒙扎等赛道抱怨的“赛车性能衰退”不同。当时，赛车会在一次练习或排位的过程中逐渐性能下降，而这次的问题更为根本。据维斯塔潘所说，这主要与方向盘传来的手感有关。
“这和赛车性能衰退完全是两回事，但手感就是达不到我想要的状态。我没法再多说什么了，否则就要开始解释一些我不想透露的东西了。”
在红牛于巴库引入升级之后，维斯塔潘曾表示他对赛车更有信心，因此能更激进地攻弯，但由于这个问题，这变得更困难了。
“在某些地方现在确实没那么容易了，是的。这和弯道类型无关，问题就是到处都存在。我只能努力去适应，但这并不容易。”
最后，维斯塔潘明确表示，队友伊萨克·哈贾尔并没有遇到同样的问题。
“不，显然只有我这边有问题。这不危险，但开起来就是不舒服。我们只能设法解决它。很长一段时间里它都运转良好，但到了巴西突然就不行了，在这里也一样。”
detailEn: Max Verstappen reveals mysterious Red Bull issue that cannot be fixed in Las Vegas
Just as in Brazil, the RB22 did not feel right for Verstappen. The Dutchman cannot reveal sensitive information, but suggests Red Bull may not be able to resolve the issue this year
Thanks to Kimi Antonelli's grid penalty, Max Verstappen will start Formula 1's Las Vegas Grand Prix from pole position, but that is not necessarily a reason for the Dutchman to be satisfied.

Yes, Red Bull has made significant progress with its power unit on energy-poor circuits and, following the balance problems during free practice, the team also managed to make effective set-up changes, but the feeling behind the wheel was still not what Verstappen believes it should be.

“Already since Brazil I have some weird issues in the car and that continued this weekend. I'm just trying to get my head around how to deal with that for the remainder of the weekend,” Verstappen said.
"That didn't make things easy in FP3, but I think in qualifying we managed to make it work."
When Verstappen was asked during the press conference whether he could elaborate on those “weird issues”, he responded firmly: "No."

Nevertheless, the subject naturally came up again during his subsequent Dutch media session in the paddock. Verstappen was still unable to go into detail, but did shed a little more light on the situation.
"It's not a balance problem, I can tell you that. There's simply something wrong with the car, but we can't fix it right now," the Red Bull driver said when asked about the issue by Motorsport.com.
"We know where the problem is coming from, but we can't solve it. It's now the second weekend in a row that it's been like this, but I can't say too much about it."

On the face of it, the issue appeared to emerge during the race in Brazil. After all, Verstappen reported that the car felt very different during the second and third stints compared to the opening stint, but the Dutchman clarified that the problem had actually been troubling him for longer.
"It suddenly appeared in Brazil, yes, but that was already before the race. I had problems there throughout the entire weekend."

The four-time world champion clarified that it is different from the 'car degradation' he complained about at circuits including Monza. Back then, the car would deteriorate over the course of a session, whereas this time the issue is more fundamental. According to Verstappen, it is mainly related to the feeling through the steering wheel.

"It's something completely different from car degradation, but the feeling is simply not how I want it to be. I can't say much more about it, because otherwise I'll start explaining things that I don't want to give away."

Following the introduction of Red Bull's Baku upgrade, Verstappen said he had gained more confidence in the car and could therefore attack the corners more aggressively, but that has become more difficult because of this issue.
"In certain places that's less the case now, yes. It doesn't matter what type of corner it is, either. The problem is simply there everywhere. I just have to try to adapt, but that's not easy."
Finally, Verstappen made it clear that team-mate Isack Hadjar is not experiencing the same problem.

"No, apparently it's only on my side. It's not dangerous, but it's just not pleasant for me to drive. We just have to try to solve it. It had been working well for a very long time, but suddenly it wasn't in Brazil, and it isn't here either."

items.originalTitle: Lando Norris frustrated by McLaren's "shocking" top speed at Las Vegas GP qualifying
items.summaryEn: Lando Norris criticised McLaren's "shocking" straightline speed after missing out on pole at the Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix. He was fourth fastest on Friday night, 0.351s off pacesetter Kimi Antonelli, with Max Verstappen and George Russell also quicker.
detailZh: 诺里斯对迈凯伦在拉斯维加斯大奖赛排位赛中“糟糕透顶”的直道速度感到沮丧
这位迈凯伦车手在最后一个计时段比全场最快者慢了近0.8秒
诺里斯在F1拉斯维加斯大奖赛排位赛无缘杆位后，批评迈凯伦赛车“糟糕透顶”的直道速度。
这位2025年世界冠军在周五夜间于内华达州位列第四，落后杆位得主安东内利0.351秒，维斯塔潘和拉塞尔也比他更快。
诺里斯的差距主要出现在最后一个计时段，他在那里比接替其世界冠军头衔的维斯塔潘慢了0.776秒，尽管他在前两个计时段更快——甚至在第二计时段全场最快。
但最后一个计时段通常决定拉斯维加斯这条低低下压力街道赛道的单圈成绩，因为其中包含1.2英里全油门的大直道赛段，以及最后一个弯角前0.5英里的直道。
“我们在直道上简直糟透了，”诺里斯说道，由于安东内利因更换新的内燃机被罚退五位，他将从第三位发车。
“就像，在直道上太可怕了。我的单圈非常好。那很容易是我最好的一圈。但我们就是，是的，跟基米相比，我们在最后一个计时段慢了0.8秒。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里，迈凯伦；兰多·诺里斯，迈凯伦
“他获得了完美的尾流，做得非常出色。但与大多数其他人相比，我们落后太多了。
“我必须在距离前车1.5秒的位置开始我的飞驰圈，这意味着在每个弯道我都会损失至少0.05到0.1秒，因为我损失了太多的下压力。
“最终，拥有良好的尾流显然能带来更大的收益，但我们不得不弥补直线速度的严重损失——因此我们不得不牺牲我们的过弯速度。
“所以总的来说，在空气下压力和阻力方面，我们就是没有找到正确的平衡。是的，这让我们根本无法去争夺杆位，这是肯定的。”
由于迈凯伦在2026年新规下难以优化梅赛德斯引擎，直线速度今年一直是他们持续存在的问题。
由于今年动力单元的复杂性，厂商车队一直占据着先发优势，因此迈凯伦在其他低下压力赛道上的挣扎在2026年一直很突出。
在蒙扎，他们排位赛获得第三和第九后，正赛以第四和第五完赛；在巴库，他们排位赛获得第三和第五，却未能拿到积分；而在奥地利，他们从第六和第七位发车后，正赛以第四和第七完赛。
诺里斯补充道：“你不能怪直道，只是我们的车不够好。我们必须在这方面大幅改进。在蒙扎、这里、巴库，你都无法竞争。”
队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在拉斯维加斯比诺里斯经历了更大的困难，这位澳大利亚车手仅排名第七快，比安东内利的梅赛德斯慢了多达1.006秒。
皮亚斯特里在最后一个计时段也很挣扎，比这位意大利车手慢了0.837秒，他的问题源于缺乏尾流，而尾流在排位赛中如此抢手。
“第三阶段排位赛由于几个原因有点混乱，”皮亚斯特里说，他将因更换新引擎而接受发车位后退10位的处罚。
“想要获得合适的尾流，如果你没处理好，那还不如干脆别出去跑。
“即便是在这里开启一圈，我觉得赛车之间也有点差异，它们在进入1号弯时消耗多少能量，如果那有半秒之差，到了这一圈后面的直道上就可能变成三四成的差距。
“所以这很难处理好，我觉得有几件事我们大概会复盘一下，看看能不能做得稍微好一点。但我觉得我的圈速有点乱。”
detailEn: Lando Norris frustrated by McLaren's "shocking" top speed at Las Vegas GP qualifying
The McLaren driver was close to eight tenths off the pace in the final sector
Lando Norris lamented McLaren’s “shocking” straightline speed after missing out on pole at the Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix.
The 2025 world champion was fourth fastest on Friday night in Nevada and 0.351s off pacesetter Kimi Antonelli, with Max Verstappen and George Russell also quicker.
Norris’s deficit largely came in the final sector where he was 0.776s slower than his world champion successor, despite being faster in the first two - even quickest of all in the second.
But the final sector is usually what defines a lap around the low-downforce Vegas street track due to its 1.2-mile flat-out Strip section, plus the 0.5-mile straight ahead of the final corner.
“We're just shocking in the straights,” said Norris, who will start from third due to Antonelli’s five-place grid drop for a new internal combustion engine.
“Like, horrendous in the straights. My lap was very good. It was easily my best lap. But we're just, yeah, to Kimi we're eight-tenths off in the last sector.
Oscar Piastri, McLaren, Lando Norris, McLaren
“He has a perfect tow and he does a very good job. But comparing to most other people, we're too far off.
“I have to start my lap 1.5 seconds off the car ahead, which means in every corner I'm losing at least half a tenth to a tenth because of how much downforce I'm losing.

“There's obviously a bigger gain at the end of the day in having a good slipstream, but we're having to make up for a really terrible loss of straightline speed - and therefore we have to harm our cornering speed.
“So we just haven't got the right balance, all in all, in terms of downforce, drag. Yeah, so it's made our life impossible to fight for pole, that's for sure.”
Straightline speed has been a continuous problem for McLaren this year due to its struggles optimising the Mercedes engine under the new-for-2026 regulations.
Factory teams have held a pre-standing advantage due to the complexity of this year’s power units and so McLaren’s struggles at other low-downforce circuits has been prevalent in 2026.

In Monza it finished fourth and fifth after qualifying third and ninth, Baku it qualified third and fifth but failed to score a point, while in Austria it finished fourth and seventh after starting sixth and seventh.
“You can't blame the straights, it's just our car is not good,” added Norris. “We have to improve that a lot. You cannot fight at Monza, here, Baku."
Team-mate Oscar Piastri endured bigger struggles than Norris in Las Vegas as the Australian was only seventh fastest and a significant 1.006s slower than Antonelli’s Mercedes.
Piastri also struggled in the final sector, 0.837s slower than the Italian, with his problems stemming from a lack of a tow, which was so sought after in qualifying.
“Q3 was just a bit messy for a few reasons,” said Piastri, who will take a 10-place grid penalty for a new engine.
“Trying to get the right slipstream is, you might as well not even go out if you don't get that right.

“Even opening the lap here, I think there's a bit of a difference between cars, how much energy they use to Turn 1 and if that's half a second, that can be the difference of three or four tenths down the straight later in the lap.
“So it's difficult to get right and I think there are a few things that we probably will review and see if we can do a slightly better job. But I think my laps were a little bit messy.”

items.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli topped qualifying but will start sixth after a five-place grid penalty for taking a new Mercedes ADUO turbocharger, while Oscar Piastri drops from seventh to 17th for the same component.
detailZh: 由于多项发车格罚退，2026年F1拉斯维加斯站的正赛发车格与排位赛结果大不相同。
安东内利在排位赛中排名第一，但本周末他因更换新的梅赛德斯ADUO涡轮增压器被罚退五位，因此不会从杆位发车。

detailEn: The starting grid for Formula 1's 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix is a very different picture from the qualifying result thanks to multiple grid penalties.
Kimi Antonelli topped qualifying, but he won't start from pole position because he has a five-place grid penalty for taking the new Mercedes ADUO turbocharger this weekend.
He'll start from sixth place instead.

Oscar Piastri qualified seventh, but he'll start 17th because he took the new ADUO turbocharger (his penalty is twice that of Antonelli's because it's his first turbocharger breach, while Antonelli's is his second).

Carlos Sainz will move back six of his 10 places from 14th to 20th while Lance Stroll will go from 20th to 21st for a 10-place grid penalty. Ollie Bearman will remain 22nd and last after his 35-place engine penalty.

items.originalTitle: “We lost one second down the straight” – Charles Leclerc upset with Ferrari’s “crazy” Las Vegas deficiency
items.summaryEn: Both Ferraris were eliminated in Q2 at the Las Vegas Grand Prix, leaving Charles Leclerc "very disappointed" with the team's performance as he pointed to a one-second loss on the straights.
detailZh: “我们在直道上损失了一秒”——查尔斯·勒克莱尔对法拉利在拉斯维加斯的“疯狂”短板感到不满
勒克莱尔未能在内华达州的排位赛中进入Q3——他将原因归结为多种因素的叠加
查尔斯·勒克莱尔对法拉利在F1拉斯维加斯大奖赛上的表现“非常失望”，因为两辆赛车均在Q2被淘汰。
勒克莱尔与队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿在第三次练习赛中分别排名第四和第八——那是唯一一节干地自由练习——但随后在排位赛中经历了更艰难的局面。
这位摩纳哥车手在Q1中确实取得了第三名，而汉密尔顿在底板受损后仅列第13位，但在Q2中两人分别只能排在第11和第12位，这是法拉利自2021年比利时大奖赛以来并列最差的结果。
法拉利因发动机功率低于对手而缺乏极速，这是SF-26表现不佳的一个突出因素，但勒克莱尔也提到了他在7号弯的锁死，以及总体上车队执行不力的问题。
“整体上我非常失望，”这位摩纳哥车手说。“当然，Q2中的失误让我们付出了代价，但我认为这是在管理一切、交通和其他事情的方式上犯了很多错误后积累的许多挫败感所致。
“这没有帮助，尤其是在这样一条一切都关乎轮胎的赛道上，你必须把轮胎带入正确的工作窗口。我更多是在看后视镜，试图自己理解交通状况；这让做任何事情都变得非常困难。”
“我们在直道上损失了一秒，这太疯狂了；这是意料之中的，而这使得在最后阶段很难追回任何东西。这是本赛季对动力最敏感的赛道，所以我们预料到会很艰难，但我原本期望能进入Q3的。”
尽管他澄清自己确实设法让轮胎进入了正确的工作窗口，勒克莱尔承认这对法拉利来说又是一个问题——也是他和汉密尔顿没有互相拉尾流的原因。
“没有讨论过（拉尾流），”勒克莱尔说。“对我们来说，保持轮胎温度是最重要的，我们知道这是我们的弱点；即使在冷却圈，我们也必须推进以保持轮胎高温。
“我不知道其他人是否面临和我们一样的问题，但当你遇到那个问题时，就很难等待两辆车并把握好时机，因为那要求你开得比你能做到的更慢，而对我们来说，让那些轮胎保持在正确温度是非常非常棘手的。”
由于奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里因超出动力单元配额而被罚退10位，加之其他多位车手同样受罚，勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿将在周六的正赛中分别从第10位和第11位起步。
detailEn: “We lost one second down the straight” – Charles Leclerc upset with Ferrari’s “crazy” Las Vegas deficiency
Leclerc didn’t make it to Q3 in the Nevadan qualifying session – and blamed a combination of factors
Charles Leclerc is “very disappointed” with Ferrari’s performance at Formula 1’s Las Vegas Grand Prix as both cars were eliminated in Q2.
Leclerc and team-mate Lewis Hamilton were fourth and eighth in FP3 - the only dry-weather free practice session - but later endured a tougher qualifying.

The Monegasque did take third position in Q1 while Hamilton struggled to 13th after picking up floor damage, but in Q2 neither could do any better than 11th and 12th, marking Ferrari’s joint-worst result since the 2021 Belgian Grand Prix.

Ferrari’s lack of top speed due to lower engine power than its rivals was a prominent factor in the SF-26’s poor performance, but Leclerc also mentioned his Turn 7 lock-up and, overall, poor execution from the Scuderia.

“I'm very disappointed as a whole,” the Monegasque said. “Of course there's the mistake in Q2 that we paid the price of, but I think that is following a lot of frustration building up with a lot of mistakes with the way we managed everything, traffic and other things.

“That doesn't help, particularly on a track like this where it's all about tyres, you’ve got to put tyres in the right window. I was more looking in my mirrors and trying to understand the traffic myself; that makes it very difficult to do anything.

“We lost one second down the straight, which is crazy; it's expected, and that makes it very difficult to recover anything at the end. It's the most power-sensitive track of the season so we expected to have a hard time, but I was expecting to go through Q3, though.”

Although he clarified that he did manage to put his tyres in the right window, Leclerc admitted that this had been another issue for Ferrari – and a reason why he and Hamilton did not tow one another.

“[The tow] was not discussed,” Leclerc said. “Keeping just the temperature in the tyres was the most important for us, we know it's our weakness; even in the cool-down laps we've got to push to keep the tyres high.

“I don't know if the others are facing the same issues as we do, but when you have that problem then it's very difficult to wait for the two cars and to time it well, because that requires you to go slower than what you can, and it's very, very tricky for us to keep those tyres in the right temperatures.”
Leclerc and Hamilton will start the race from 10th and 11th on Saturday, courtesy of Oscar Piastri’s 10-place penalty for exceeding his power unit allocation amid many other grid drops.
keyPointsZh: 勒克莱尔与队友汉密尔顿在第三次练习赛中分别排名第四和第八，该节是唯一一节干地练习。
勒克莱尔在Q1取得第三名，而汉密尔顿仅列第13位。
keyPointsEn: Leclerc and team-mate Lewis Hamilton were fourth and eighth in FP3, the only dry-weather free practice session.
Leclerc took third position in Q1, while Hamilton struggled to 13th.

items.titleZh: 诺里斯：迈凯伦直道速度糟糕，塑料袋卡底板
items.summaryZh: 诺里斯在F1拉斯维加斯大奖赛排位赛后称迈凯伦直道速度"糟糕"且"可怕"，他Q3仅列第四，因安东内利受罚正赛将从第三位发车。车队领队斯特拉还提到，诺里斯车底卡入塑料袋损失了下压力。
items.originalTitle: Plastic bag and a 'horrendous' weakness hurt Norris in Vegas
items.summaryEn: Lando Norris called McLaren's straightline speed "shocking" and "horrendous" after qualifying at the 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix, where he was fourth fastest in Q3 and will start third thanks to a grid penalty for Kimi Antonelli. Team principal Andrea Stella also said a plastic bag got stuck in Norris's floor, costing significant downforce.
detailZh: 诺里斯在错过F1 2026年拉斯维加斯大奖赛杆位后，称迈凯伦的直道速度"糟糕"且"可怕"。
诺里斯在Q3中排名第四，由于新科世界冠军、杆位得主基米·安东内利受罚，他正赛将从第三位发车，但他对落后0.351秒感到沮丧。
"我们在直道上就是糟糕，"诺里斯说，"直道上简直可怕。
"我的这一圈非常好，轻松是我最好的一圈。但和基米相比，我们在最后一段慢了0.8秒。
“他获得了完美的尾流，而且他做得非常好。但与大多数其他人相比，我们落后太多了。”
“我必须在距离前车1.5秒的位置开始我的飞驰圈，这意味着在每个弯道，由于损失了太多下压力，我至少会损失0.05到0.1秒。”
“最终，拥有良好的尾流显然能带来更大的收益，但我们必须弥补直道速度的严重损失，因此不得不损害我们的过弯速度。”
“所以总的来说，在下压力和阻力方面，我们就是没有找到正确的平衡。这让我们的赛车无法争夺杆位。”
车队领队安德烈亚·斯特拉还提出了诺里斯一方一个不同寻常的额外减轻因素。
“我想特别提一下，尤其是在兰多这边，他相当不走运，因为塑料袋卡在了底板里，我们在那里损失了相当多的下压力，”斯特拉解释道。
“所以，考虑到十分之一秒本会带来很大差别，那个塑料袋上肯定值十分之一秒，这有点可惜。”
队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在Q3中落后超过一秒，仅列第七，被小红牛的阿尔维德·林德布拉德击败。
尽管诺里斯将迈凯伦在直道上的劣势描述为“全年都存在的一个问题”，但皮亚斯特里觉得，迈凯伦在拉斯维加斯损失如此之大，让他们“有点措手不及”。
“我不认为我们预料到这会成为这么大的问题，”他说。“在蒙扎我们还可以，对我们来说奇怪的部分是，这主要是和其他梅赛德斯动力赛车相比。”
“所以，也许很多人减少了空气下压力，而我们减得不够。但这看起来是我们缺失的相当大的一步。”
斯特拉表示，迈凯伦“对这条赛道的要求是否适合我们的赛车有一些担忧”，因为车队采用了更短的齿比，而且已知在产生与动力单元供应商梅赛德斯相同的直道性能方面存在弱点。
斯特拉总结道：“当然，我们在这里看到了与蒙扎和巴库类似的趋势，而且在所有条件下我们都不是特别有竞争力。”
“混乱”还是执行得当？
皮亚斯特里称第三阶段排位赛对迈凯伦来说是一场“混乱”的 session，留下了“一些我们可能会复盘并看看能否做得稍好一点的事情”。
皮亚斯特里补充道：“甚至在这里开启一圈时，赛车之间就有一些差异，它们在进入1号弯时消耗多少能量，如果那是半秒，那可能在圈速后段直道上就是三到四成的差距。”
“所以这很难做对，但我觉得我的圈速也有点乱。”
正如安东内利的杆位圈所展示的，这一切都被尾流效应极大地压倒了——如果执行得当，这能带来相当可观的额外圈速。
“我觉得法拉利就是完美的例子，”皮亚斯特里说。“他们没获得尾流，或者尾流不够大，结果他们在Q2就被淘汰了。
“说实话，我认为前四名车队中的任何一支，如果没获得尾流，都可能遭遇同样的情况。
“所以，在这类赛道上驾驶这些赛车时，这是非常重要的一部分，你只能将就着应对，因为也许完美的轮胎升温能让你快个零点一秒或零点二秒，但你看基米，他在最后一个计时段比我快了一秒。”
“无论你在轮胎上获得多少优势，你总是会在尾流上失去它，而且失去的远不止这些。”
斯特拉认为迈凯伦很好地执行了那部分。
“我们在这里做得更好的是，通过在排位赛中占据非常好的位置来减轻这一[弱点]，”斯特拉说。
“在排位赛中，赛车基本达到了我们想要的状态，这无疑帮了大忙，因为我得说，在这些规则下，跟随一辆车甚至多辆车时的阻力减少比过去更多，因此处在正确位置的激励甚至更高。”
“我认为这在排位赛中效果很好。”
detailEn: Lando Norris called McLaren's straightline speed "shocking" and "horrendous" after missing out on pole position for Formula 1's 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix.

Norris was fourth fastest in Q3 and will start the race third on the grid thanks to a grid penalty for new world champion and pole winner Kimi Antonelli, but was frustrated to be 0.351 seconds off the pace.
"We're just shocking in the straights," Norris said. "Like, horrendous in the straight.
"My lap was very good and it was easily my best lap. But to Kimi, we're eight tenths off in the last sector.
"He has a perfect tow and he does a very good job. But comparing to most other people, we're too far off.
"I have to start my lap 1.5 seconds off the car ahead, which means in every corner I'm losing at least a half a tenth to a tenth because of how much downforce I'm losing.

"There's obviously a bigger gain at the end of the day in having a good slipstream, but we're having to make up for a pretty terrible loss of straightline speed and therefore we have to harm our cornering speed.
"So we just haven't got the right balance, all in all, in terms of downforce, drag. It's made our life impossible to fight for our pole."
Team principal Andrea Stella also offered an unusual extra mitigating factor on Norris's side.
"I would like to mention that especially on Lando's side he has been quite unlucky, because the plastic bag got stuck in the floor and we lost quite a lot of downforce there," Stella explained.
"So, considering that one tenth of a second would have made a big difference, certainly there was one tenth of a second on a plastic bag, which is a bit of a shame."
Team-mate Oscar Piastri was over a second off the pace down in seventh, beaten by the Racing Bulls of Arvid Lindblad in Q3.

And even though Norris described McLaren's deficit on the straights as something that's "been an issue all year", Piastri felt McLaren had been "caught a bit by surprise" by how much it was losing out in Vegas.
"I don't think we expected it to be such a big problem," he said. "At Monza we were OK, and the strange part for us is it's mostly compared to the other Mercedes-powered cars.
"So, maybe a lot of people took downforce off, and we didn't take enough off. But it seems like a pretty massive step that we were missing."

Stella said McLaren had "some concerns in terms of how suitable the demand of this circuit would be for our car" because of the team's shorter gear ratios and its known weakness in generating the same straightline performance as power unit supplier Mercedes.
"Certainly we have seen here trends that are similar to Monza and Baku, and in all conditions we were not particularly competitive," Stella summarised.
'Messy' or well executed?
Piastri called Q3 a "messy" session for McLaren, which left "a few things that we probably will review and see if we can do a slightly better job".

"Even opening the lap here, there's a bit of a difference between cars, how much energy they use to Turn 1, and if that's half a second, that can be the difference of three or four tenths down the straight later in the lap," Piastri added.
"So it's difficult to get right, but I think also my laps were a little bit messy as well."
As Antonelli's pole lap showed, all of this was massively overwhelmed by the towing effect - which was worth a significant chunk of extra laptime if executed correctly.
"I think Ferrari is the perfect example," Piastri said. "They didn't get a slipstream, or not a big enough slipstream, and they're out in Q2.
"I think honestly, any of the top four teams could have done the same thing if they didn't get a tow.

"So, it's a massive part of these kind of tracks in these cars, and you kind of just have to make do because maybe you can gain a tenth or two with the perfect [tyre] warm-up, but you look at Kimi, he's one second faster than me in the last sector.
"No matter what you gain on the tyres, you're always going to lose it and a lot more on the tow."
Stella felt McLaren had executed that part well.
"What we have done better here is to mitigate this [weakness] from having really good positioning in qualifying," Stella said.

"The car was pretty much where we wanted it to be in qualifying, and this definitely helped, because I have to say that it seems like with these regulations, the drag reduction when you follow one car or even multiple cars is more than in the past, and therefore there is an even higher incentive to be positioned in the right place.
"I think this worked well in qualifying."

斯特拉表示塑料袋卡在诺里斯车底，损失了相当多的下压力。

Norris said he was eight tenths off Antonelli in the last sector and noted Antonelli had a perfect tow.
Stella said a plastic bag got stuck in Norris's floor and cost quite a lot of downforce.

items.titleZh: 拉斯维加斯大奖赛排位赛：赢家与输家
items.summaryZh: 受雨水影响的练习赛让拉斯维加斯大奖赛排位赛更看重车手能否在第三节练习赛迅速进入状态。法拉利双车止步第二节排位赛，勒克莱尔在7号弯失误，汉密尔顿从第三节练习赛起表现不佳。
items.originalTitle: Winners and losers from F1 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix qualifying
items.summaryEn: Rain-affected practice sessions put extra emphasis on hitting the ground running in FP3 and carrying that form into Las Vegas Grand Prix qualifying. Ferrari suffered a double Q2 exit, with Charles Leclerc making a mistake at Turn 7 and Lewis Hamilton struggling from FP3 onwards.
detailZh: 受雨水影响的F1练习赛意味着，人们更加看重在第三节练习赛（FP3）中迅速进入状态，并把这种状态延续到拉斯维加斯大奖赛排位赛中。
谁在关键时刻顶住了，谁又没能兑现此前的势头？
对法拉利来说，这是跌宕起伏的一年，但在拉斯维加斯双车止步第二节排位赛（Q2）无疑是低谷之一——即便这条赛道的复杂特性让它有些特殊。
夏尔·勒克莱尔在7号弯出现失误，未能完成第二个计时圈；而刘易斯·汉密尔顿从第三节练习赛起就显得缺乏说服力。
勒克莱尔迅速指出，这个失误是“在大量挫败感之后发生的，随着我们在管理交通状况等方面犯下许多错误而不断累积”，并表示法拉利可能是第三次练习赛中出现的GPS问题的受害者。
他补充说，法拉利必须全神贯注于提升轮胎温度，因为这是车队的“弱点”。
汉密尔顿实事求是地谈到了他认为法拉利在哪里吃亏，他说：“在直道上损失很大一块。感觉我们没有很强的抓地力。我们一直很难让轮胎进入工作状态，我们就是有点找不到方向。”
这很好地总结了情况。
车队表示，他的最后一圈“非常非常好”，所以显然车队对汉密尔顿跑出的这一圈并不失望。
而汉密尔顿认为，在第一节排位赛中丢失一块底板部件，单是下压力就让他损失了“零点三到零点四秒”，同时他还声称，一个部署问题是他第二节排位赛最后一圈的重大阻碍。——杰克·贝尼恩
说到安东内利的第三节排位赛，很难不套用拉斯维加斯的赌博老梗。
他做出了冒险决定，在5号弯减速让行，掉到车阵末尾。要是他晚几秒到达起跑线，他甚至根本无法开始自己的飞驰圈。
相反，他刚好及时赶上，并发现自己处于完美的位置，在圈末借助多辆车的尾流直冲终点线，跑出最快圈速，巧妙地将他因更换引擎而受的五位发车格罚退的痛苦降到最低。
尽管或许有一点幸运，但这很好地体现了安东内利今年全程处理事情有多么出色。他游走在灾难的边缘，只为碾压所有人。
而且从发车格第六位起步，谁又敢赌他不会在正赛中迅速跻身维斯塔潘和拉塞尔之间呢？——乔什·萨蒂尔
安东内利的发车格罚退将把拉塞尔提升到发车格第二位，但考虑到拉塞尔在第三节练习中领先九成（0.9秒）的强势表现，排位赛会让人觉得错失良机。
事实上，拉塞尔在Q3的最终圈速比他在第三节练习中还要慢，他恳求的尾流最终也没有得到。
他在排位赛后的新闻发布会上圆滑地说“我们会私下沟通，可以再谈”，但对于自己的请求被拒绝，他显然感到沮丧。
尤其是因为这导致他被那位再次激怒他的车手击败，丢掉了（继承而来的）杆位。——JS
尽管报告他的红牛赛车存在“一些奇怪的问题”，维斯塔潘的表现仍足以让他成为未受罚车手中的最快者。
他不确定这些问题是否会在正赛距离中拖累他——就像在奥斯汀那样——但他已经做好了充分准备，争取在六场比赛中第四次获胜，并继续将自己确立为安东内利在2027年最大的威胁。- JS
皮埃尔·加斯利在Q2中引人注目的第二名是否让他梦想着再次挑战杆位，就像在蒙扎那样？
加斯利没有这么说，但接下来发生的事情无疑令人失望。即使期望挑战前列位置不现实，复制他Q2的圈速本可以让加斯利在Q3中排名第五，并且由于基米·安东内利的罚退，他在发车格上排名第四。
然而，准备圈没有按计划进行，带着冷胎进入第一个弯角，在第一赛段损失了“两到三个十分之一秒”，圈速就此告吹，让他落后于两位小红牛车手，仅领先于队友弗兰科·科拉平托——后者幸运地只是擦到墙壁，没有更严重的后果。
这种剧情转折恰好概括了 阿尔派 在下半赛季对小红牛的追赶。——杰克·科曾斯
阿尔维德·林德布拉德已经拿下本赛季个人最佳排位成绩，并将因安东内利的发车位罚退而进一步受益，从第五位起步。
林德布拉德今年跑出过许多非常强劲的排位圈——包括最近几场比赛，他说由于各种不同因素影响了他的成绩，这些圈速我们并未看到——但即便是他本人也不确定这一圈能否与自己的最佳表现相提并论。
“当时太混乱了，轮胎不工作，所以我出现了很多转向不足，我在8号弯犯了一点小错误，所以这不是完美的一圈，”林德布拉德在被 The Race 问及这一圈是否感觉像是他本赛季较为特别的一圈时解释道。
“但与此同时，最近几场比赛有很多事情没有按照我的意愿发展，那是我无法控制的。”
利亚姆·劳森将后退两个位置发车，因为小红牛这对组合再次在排位赛中击败了两名阿尔派车手，他们正在为车队积分榜第五名而战。劳森在Q2给了林德布拉德一个尾流，林德布拉德总结说：“我觉得其实并不完全需要，但很感激。”——JB
哈斯车队周五到来时希望让两辆车都进入Q2，并利用被罚退严重的奥利·贝尔曼为拉斐尔·卡马拉提供尾流，以获得更好的发车位。
但首次使用干胎（光头胎）跑圈意味着那些期望很快被重新调整。
贝尔曼表示：“不幸的是，我们的速度不够快。我们在第三节练习中已经证明了这一点。所以，是的，我没能完成一个计时圈，我只是在努力帮助拉法晋级。基本上，要让两辆车都进入第二节排位赛，那会太困难了。”
事实证明，要让哪怕一辆车进入第二节排位赛都太困难了——尽管贝尔曼做出了“惊人的表现”，这是排位第17名的卡马拉所说的，他表示对队友“不能要求更多了”。
再加上贝尔曼在第三节练习中于第一个弯道出现了一次诡异的打转——用他的话说，这与哈斯车队的“排位赛引擎映射以及后刹车基本上如何与MGU-K相互作用”有关——而卡马拉在第一节排位赛中实际上复制了同样的情况，这些加在一起，构成了哈斯车队一段时间以来在性能方面最艰难的一天。——JC
detailEn: The rain-affected Formula 1 practice sessions meant there was added emphasis on hitting the ground running in FP3 and carrying that through into Las Vegas Grand Prix qualifying.
Who nailed it when it mattered most, and who failed to deliver on their earlier promise?
It's been a rollercoaster year for Ferrari, but a double-Q2 exit in Las Vegas has to be one of the lowest moments - even if the intricacies of this track make it a bit of an outlier.
Charles Leclerc made a mistake at Turn 7 and failed to get a second lap in, while Lewis Hamilton didn't look convincing from FP3 onwards.

Leclerc was quick to point out the mistake was "following a lot of frustration, building up with a lot of mistakes with the way we managed" traffic, among other things, and said Ferrari might have been a victim of a GPS issue that hit during FP3.
He added that Ferrari had to be fully focused on gaining tyre temperature because that is the team's "weakness".

Giving a matter-of-fact take on where he thought Ferrari was losing out, Hamilton said: "It's a big chunk on the straights. It didn't feel like we had a tonne of grip. We were struggling to get the tyres working and we were just kind of nowhere."
That sums it up well.
His last lap was "very, very good", according to the team, so clearly it wasn't upset with the lap Hamilton put together.

And Hamilton reckoned losing a piece of his floor in Q1 cost him "three or four tenths" in downforce alone, while he also claimed a deployment issue was a big hinderance on his final Q2 lap. - Jack Benyon
It’s difficult to resist the Vegas gambling cliches when it comes to Antonelli's Q3.
He made the risky decision to back off at Turn 5 and drop to the back of the pack. Had he arrived at the line a couple of seconds later, he wouldn't even have been able to start his lap.

Instead, he made it just in time and found himself in the perfect place to pick up a monster, multi-car tow to the line at the end of the lap, setting the fastest time and minimising the pain of his five-place engine grid penalty brilliantly.
Albeit perhaps a touch fortunate, it was a good example of how beautifully Antonelli has played things throughout this year. Walking right up to the edge of disaster in order to crush everyone.
And from sixth on the grid, who would bet against him quickly getting himself amongst Verstappen and Russell in the race? - Josh Suttill
Antonelli's grid penalty will bump Russell up to second on the starting grid, but qualifying will feel like a missed opportunity given how strong Russell was in FP3, which he topped by nine tenths.
In fact, Russell actually ended up slower in Q3 than he'd been in FP3, left without the tow he pleaded for.
He diplomatically said "we'll take it offline, and we can talk about it" in the post-qualifying press conference, but he was clearly frustrated to have had his request denied.
Not least because it led to him being beaten to (an inherited) pole by the driver who has yet again infuriated him. - JS
Despite reporting "some weird issues" with his Red Bull, Verstappen did enough to be the fastest of the unpenalised drivers.

He wasn't sure if those issues will hamper him over a race distance - as they did at Austin - but he is well poised to fight for a fourth victory in six races and continue to set himself up as Antonelli's biggest 2027 threat. - JS
Did Pierre Gasly's eye-catching second place in Q2 have him dreaming of another challenge for pole position, a la Monza?

Gasly didn't say as much, but what came next was undoubtedly a disappointment. Even if it was unrealistic to expect a challenge for the top positions, replicating his Q2 lap would've put Gasly fifth in Q3, and fourth on the grid with Kimi Antonelli's penalty.

Instead, the prep lap didn't go to plan and, with cold tyres into the first corner, "two, three tenths" were lost in the first sector and the lap was gone, leaving him behind both Racing Bulls drivers and ahead only of team-mate Franco Colapinto - who was lucky to escape brushing the wall without more severe consequences.
It's the sort of turn of events that sums up Alpine's pursuit of Racing Bulls in the second half of the season. - Jack Cozens
Arvid Lindblad already bagged his best qualifying of the year and will benefit further from Antonelli's grid penalty to start fifth.

Lindblad's put in plenty of very strong qualifying laps this year - including in the last few races, which, he says, we haven't seen due to different things impacting his results - but even he wasn't sure this would be up there with his best.

"It was such a mess, the tyres weren't working, so I had a lot of understeer, I made a bit of a mistake in Turn 8, so it wasn't a perfect lap," Lindblad explained when asked by The Race whether it felt like one of the more special laps of his season.
"But also at the same time, there's a lot that's not gone my way the recent races, that's been out of my control."

Liam Lawson will start two places further back, as the Racing Bulls duo again outqualified the two Alpine drivers they're fighting for fifth in the constructors' championship. Lawson gave Lindblad a tow in Q2 which "I don't think it was entirely needed, but grateful", Lindblad summarised. - JB
Haas came into Friday hoping to get both cars into Q2 and using the heavily penalised Ollie Bearman to tow Rafael Camara to a better grid position.
But its first taste of slick-tyre running meant those expectations were quickly readjusted.

"Unfortunately, we weren't quick enough. We showed that in FP3," said Bearman. "So, yeah, I didn't get to set a lap, I was just trying to help Rafa to come through. It would have been too difficult basically to get both cars into Q2."
It was too difficult, it turns out, to get even one car into Q2 - despite Bearman doing "an amazing job", per 17th-place qualifier Camara, who said he "couldn't ask for more" from his team-mate.

Throw in a weird Bearman spin at the first corner in FP3 - in his words, to do with Haas's "quali engine map and how the rear brakes basically interact with the MGU-K" - that was effectively replicated by Camara in Q1, and this added up to Haas's most difficult day, performance-wise, for some time. - JC
